index 8fe02ad..ab93719 100644
--- a/app/visits.py
+++ b/app/visits.py
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
+from collections import Counter
 from datetime import datetime, timezone
 
 
@@ -5,3 +6,9 @@ def day_start(day: str) -> int:
     """The first second of a UTC day, as a Unix timestamp."""
     start = datetime.strptime(day, "%Y-%m-%d").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
     return int(start.timestamp())
+
+
+def visits_by_day(timestamps: list[int]) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """How many visits each UTC day had, from their Unix timestamps."""
+    days = Counter(datetime.fromtimestamp(ts).date().isoformat() for ts in timestamps)
+    return dict(days)

 def test_day_start_is_utc_midnight():
     assert day_start("2026-10-10") == 1791590400
+
+
+def test_visits_are_counted_by_day():
+    noon = day_start("2026-10-10") + 12 * 3600
+    next_noon = day_start("2026-10-11") + 12 * 3600
+    assert list(visits_by_day([noon, noon + 60, next_noon]).values()) == [2, 1]
